title: Cosmic Mushroom Cat
description: A fluffy white cat with green eyes sits on a large ornate mushroom, reaching toward floating bubbles in a mystical chamber. The scene is filled with glowing galaxies, aurora lights, magical symbols, an open spellbook on a red table, and a wooden sign reading 'Kundalini Spores & Nebula Spells'.
prompt: A majestic white long-haired cat with bright green eyes sits upright on an enormous intricately patterned mushroom with glowing galaxy patterns on its cap. The cat reaches one paw toward floating transparent bubbles containing tiny cats and rainbows. Surrounding the scene is a dark mystical chamber with cosmic ceiling showing swirling galaxies and aurora borealis, glowing runes, flowers, crystals, an open ancient spellbook on a red draped table, and a wooden sign that reads 'Kundalini Spores & Nebula Spells'.
